title: ChemInform Abstract: Chemistry of Phosphorus. Part 186. Tris(2,3‐di‐tert.‐butylcyclotriphosphanyl)stibane ‐ A Compound with Three P3 Rings Linked by One Antimony Atom.
abstract: AbstractThe 3:1 molar reaction of the stannylcyclotriphosphane (I) with SbCl3 (II) proceeds quantitatively giving the two configurational isomers (III) and (IV) of the title compound.
